summary.implementedScope: Implemented the Story 1 Convex archive append/read primitive, including per-process sequence assignment, process-scoped finalization-key idempotency, stable ascending reads by sequence, related-context id round-tripping, and persistence-focused coverage for the canonical archive entry contract.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead is pausing for caller ruling 01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence-story-run-001-ruling-012 before impl-lead can accept the story.

evidence: The story scope explicitly defers live finalization hooks, archive read routes/UI, and read-time provenance enrichment to later stories (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/stories/01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:36-38`, `174-178`), but the same story still requires TC-1.1a/b/c and TC-1.4a/b coverage (`.../01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:156-166`, `192-199`; `docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/test-plan.md:36-44`). Those mapped files do not exist (`tests/service/server/archive-finalization.test.ts`, `tests/service/server/archive-api.test.ts`), `rg` found no `ArchiveFinalizationService`/`appendFinalizedEntry` or `ArchiveReadService`/`getArchive` implementation under `apps/platform/server/services`, and the only executable proof is the Convex handler test (`convex/archiveEntries.test.ts:196-236`, `370-436`). That leaves finalized user/model/process-event archival and degraded related-context reads without the required story-level evidence.

`listArchiveEntries` reads `by_processId_and_sequence` with `.collect()` and only then slices in `paginateArchiveEntries` (`convex/archiveEntries.ts:139-155`, `261-280`). The story/design describe this store method as returning one bounded page (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/stories/01-canonical-archive-entry-persistence.md:126-127`; `docs/spec-build/v2/epics/07--archive-and-derived-views/tech-design.md:661-668`). The outward page contract is correct, but long-process production reads still materialize the full archive in memory.

After that ruling, run a quick fix for the non-blocking pagination materialization finding if desired, then re-verify.
